rubric.desc: Fatḥah (accept the Arabic name فتحة or the mark itself, ـَ)
Kasrah (accept the Arabic name كسرة or the mark itself, ـِ)
Ḍammah, also spelt Dhammah or Dhumma (accept the Arabic name ضمة or the mark itself, ـُ)

questions.prompt: Which letter is said at the end of the word to pronounce tanwīn?
Why is it important that we pronounce the ḥarakāt (short vowels) purely and correctly?

rubric.desc: To make sure the meaning is preserved, as changing a ḥarakah can change the meaning
